capabilities: Highlight PDF text selections with a configurable color palette
Record highlights in a companion markdown note grouped by color and sorted by page
Link note entries and PDF passages bidirectionally
Query highlights across the vault via Dataview inline fields
Cite individual highlights from any note via block embeds
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; installed via BRAT or manually. Desktop only for now (palette opens on mouse selection). Highlights live outside the PDF, so they are visible only inside Obsidian and misplace if the PDF is replaced with a different edition.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer offers no workflow for marking passages and collecting them into a note.

relations.evidence: (page:: …) and (type:: …) are Dataview inline fields, so highlights can be queried across the vault

summary: PDF annotation plugin that highlights selected text in colors, records highlights in a companion note, and links note entries to PDF passages both ways.
